title: The Artemis II backup crew on selection and training
summary: Leah Cheshire interviews Andre Douglas and Jenni Gibbons, the backup crew of Artemis II [t0]. Andre describes his selection in 2021 and the call from Reid Wiseman on the day he was picked [t587, t686]. Jenni explains that the Canadian selection runs about a year and takes fewer people [t970]. Both say their candidate training carried over to Artemis II: Andre names robotics and flying, Jenni the habit of learning a new spacecraft and switching focus [t1304, t1581]. The conversation turns to the jobs astronauts hold before a mission [t1766, t1861]. The recording ends while Andre describes the JET 5 field test [t99999].

people.speaker: Andre
